kjv: unto the region that lieth round about
even the ornament of a meek
others smote him with the palms of their hands
of the gospel is committed unto me
that which is put in to fill it up
of the things that were sold
on them that are out of the way
and took him by the throat
when he had looked round about
when they had looked round about
when he had looked round about upon
the hinder part of the ship
with the palms of their hands
which was the son of Rhesa
which was the son of Ragau
they to whom it was first
when they had further threatened them
to be brought on my way
to be brought on my way
if thou bring forward on their journey
seeing ye know these things before
by the things that are made
should get an advantage of us
to them which heretofore have sinned
to be somewhat in conference added
after that we had suffered before
to be carried away of the flood
